$comment: Advisories accepted on purpose, each with a reason and a date to look again.
Read by tools/audit-allowlist.mjs. Anything NOT listed here still fails the
gate at high or critical. An entry here stops being an exception the moment
a real fix ships or its reviewBy date passes — the checker fails in both
cases, so an accepted risk cannot quietly become a permanent one.
Do not add an entry to make a build green. Add one when the honest answer is
'there is no fix and the exposure is understood', and write down why.
An entry is matched by its GHSA id in 'advisory'. Do NOT key one on npm's
numeric advisory id: npm renumbers them. These two entries were written
down as 1138808/1138809 and npm now calls the same advisories
1239765/1239766, which made both acceptances stop matching at once --
blocking advisories that had a reviewed, in-date decision while reporting
those same entries as dead weight to delete.
